test_log_dirichlet_norm: test the _log_dirichlet_norm function computes log Dirichlet normalization correctly
test_log_wishart_norm: test the _log_wishart_norm function computes log Wishart normalization correctly
test_bayesian_mixture_weights_prior_init: test BayesianGaussianMixture weights prior initialization with custom and default weight_concentration_prior values
test_bayesian_mixture_mean_prior_initial: test BayesianGaussianMixture mean prior initialization with custom and default mean_prior and mean_precision_prior values
test_bayesian_mixture_precisions_prior_i: test BayesianGaussianMixture precisions prior initialization with custom and default degrees_of_freedom_prior and covariance_prior values
test_bayesian_mixture_check_is_fitted: test BayesianGaussianMixture raises NotFittedError when score is called before fit
test_bayesian_mixture_weights: test BayesianGaussianMixture computes correct weights for both dirichlet_distribution and dirichlet_process prior types
test_monotonic_likelihood: test that variational inference improves the training bound monotonically across iterations for all covariance and prior types
test_compare_covar_type: test that tied, diag, and spherical covariance types are consistent with full covariance after one M-step
test_check_covariance_precision: test that the dot product of covariance and precision matrices yields identity for all covariance types
test_invariant_translation: test that adding a constant to data shifts means but leaves weights and covariances unchanged
test_bayesian_mixture_fit_predict: test that fit_predict returns the same labels as fit followed by predict for various seeds and convergence settings
test_bayesian_mixture_fit_predict_n_init: test that fit_predict matches fit.predict when n_init is greater than 1
test_bayesian_mixture_predict_predict_pr: test that predict matches argmax of predict_proba and achieves high adjusted_rand_score on synthetic data
